topics.label: Introduction to the Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing and context for the lecture on complement.

topics.label: Fundamentals and Central Role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational concepts and nomenclature of the complement system, focusing on C3 as the central fulcrum.

topics.label: Complement Activation Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the recognition mechanisms that initiate complement activation across distinct pathways and lead to the trigger threshold.

topics.label: Effector Mechanisms of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the downstream effector processes through which activated complement destroys pathogens and mediates inflammation.

topics.label: Host Regulation of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the regulatory proteins and mechanisms that protect host cells from accidental complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Clinical Manifestations of Complement Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic analyzes the distinct clinical presentations and pathology arising from deficiencies in specific complement pathway components.

topics.label: Pathogen Evasion and Applications
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the strategies pathogens use to circumvent complement attack and how these bacterial factors are applied in medicine and research.

topics.label: Conclusion and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing and a preview of the upcoming lecture topic.
